# Complete Assembly source fixture

`reboot.asm` is the complete 504-byte `v4.0/src/CMD/FDISK/REBOOT.ASM` from
[microsoft/MS-DOS](https://github.com/microsoft/MS-DOS). Its SHA-256 is
`fdec55bdd18b02f2854dbe9fbe72ab1c506b92ede891c69c1cf893e1452bf263`.
The physical source retains all 42 CRLF pairs and its final DOS EOF byte.
The original corpus manifest authenticates these exact bytes; an upstream
commit association has not been independently established for this fixture.

`LICENSE` is the complete 1,096-byte MIT notice supplied with that repository,
SHA-256 `5941221227eb7e4bd0ed4e905762899428b9be84a1c730ce24d076da1ede1eac`.
Original authorship and license terms remain intact.

The fixture tests written names, direct physical containment and current-source
coordinates. Its unsupported outer syntax remains visible; no trimming,
assembler execution, macro expansion, register binding or runtime claims are
part of this fixture's contract.
